y0: A Man Calling in the Wilderness
y1: A man named John the Baptist appeared in the wilderness. He wore clothes made of camel's hair and ate locusts and wild honey.
y2: John said in a loud voice, “Repent! The kingdom of heaven has come near!” To repent means to turn away from a bad way and return to God.
y4: Many people came to John and confessed their sins. John baptized them in the Jordan River.
y5: John said, “After me comes Someone much greater than me. I am not even worthy to carry His sandals.”
y7: One day, Jesus came to the Jordan River to be baptized. John was surprised and said, “I need to be baptized by You, and do You come to me?”
y8: Jesus said, “Let it be so now, this is right.” So, John baptized Jesus.
y10: When Jesus came up out of the water, the heavens opened. God's Holy Spirit came down on Jesus like a dove.
y11: A voice came from heaven: “This is my beloved Son, with whom I am well pleased.”
verse: “This is my beloved Son, with whom I am well pleased.”
prayer: Lord God, thank You for calling me Your beloved child, just as You called Jesus Your beloved Son. When I make a mistake, help me to return to You without hiding. Holy Spirit, help me. I pray in the name of Jesus Christ. Amen.
d0: wilderness. A dry place where almost no one lives. John shared God's word in the wilderness.
d1: John the Baptist. A man who prepared the way for Jesus' coming. He is called "the Baptist" because he baptized people. John the Baptist was a relative of Jesus.
d2: Repent. To admit your mistakes, turn away from a bad way, and return to God. John called out, “Repent!”
d3: The kingdom of heaven. The kingdom where God rules as King. When Jesus came, the kingdom of heaven came near.
d4: Jordan River. A river in Israel that flows from north to south. John baptized people in the Jordan River.
d5: baptize. A ceremony of dipping in water or pouring water to show that someone has returned to God. Jesus was also baptized by John.
d6: Holy Spirit. The Spirit of God. He came down like a dove when Jesus was baptized. The Holy Spirit helps us follow Jesus.
